photos.caption: The high ledge (old attic floor) and attic window, from the lounge

current.summary: What remains of the attic is the raised ledge above the daybed in the lounge, with the lit recesses and the small attic window. Plan: tile it (lounge job 1) and add a balustrade rail along its edge (job 2). How it will be used — display, storage or somewhere to sit — is still open.
issues: Decide the use: it sets the balustrade height and how you get up there
